exact_reduction.q: q0+2*sqrt(R), where q0=sum over graph nonedges p_i*p_j and R=sum over the eight four-holes product_{i in C}p_i
exact_reduction.consequence: the remaining inequality implies beta(G,w)<=3/2 via the three-mode characteristic polynomial

proved_primitive_face_lemma.scope: support contained in {0,1,2} union C for C in the first five listed holes; these are exactly the supports on which only the named quartic monomial in R survives
proved_primitive_face_lemma.fifth_face_note: on the fifth face the 2x2 determinant K obeys p0*p1*p2<=x*K, so the same three-variable expression is an upper bound
proved_primitive_face_lemma.one_variable_substitution: for fixed y, E increases with sqrt(xz), so x=z=(L-y)/2; set y=s^2/6
proved_primitive_face_lemma.consequence: inequality (A) is proved on all five primitive one-channel support faces; the other three listed hole supports activate three quartic monomials and remain only numerically audited

proved_coupled_channel_stationarity_lemm.fixed_data: p0,...,p6 and X,Y; the p7,p8 and p3,p5 splits vary through x,y
proved_coupled_channel_stationarity_lemm.consequence: outside the wedge where p0 lies strictly between p1 and p2 with sufficient separation, a coupled-channel maximum must move to a heavy-split boundary

proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.scope: the four heavy coordinates p3,p5,p7,p8 with all five light coordinates held fixed and positive
proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.prior_wedge: by the two-split lemma, only p0 strictly between p1 and p2 can remain; use symmetry to write p1=p0+x and p2=p0-y with x>=0 and 0<y<p0
proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.stationary_hessian: sqrt(R)*Hess(objective)=M=Hess(R)-v*v^T/2 on the three-dimensional heavy simplex
proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.determinant: det(M)=p0*P(x)/2, where P is quadratic in x with leading coefficient p0*p4^2
proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.consequence: det(M)>0, whereas a negative-semidefinite 3x3 Hessian has nonpositive determinant; therefore no fully interior heavy-simplex local maximum exists
proved_full_heavy_interior_exclusion.remaining_boundary: for every fixed light profile, a maximizer has at least one of p3,p5,p7,p8 equal to zero

proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.scope: all five light coordinates positive and exactly one of p3,p5,p7,p8 zero
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.p5_zero_parameterization: write p1=p0+x, sqrt(R)=p4*(p6+h); KKT positivity gives x,h>0
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.p5_zero_elimination: after three linear KKT eliminations, the remaining equations force h/p6=42/5 and p0/p6=21/20
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.p3_zero_exclusion: with p1=p0+x and sqrt(R)=p6*k, exact row reduction gives (p4-k)*p7=0; p7>0 forces k=p4 and then the two remaining heavy equations sum to p1*(p4+p8)>0, a contradiction
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.symmetry: the atom automorphism maps p5-zero to p8-zero and p3-zero to p7-zero
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.consequence: a global maximizer with all five light coordinates positive has at least two heavy coordinates equal to zero
proved_three_heavy_relative_interior_cla.remaining_boundary: two-or-fewer-heavy strata and strata with a zero light coordinate

proved_two_heavy_spectral_faces.already_primitive: the {p3,p7} face is the fifth primitive face
proved_two_heavy_spectral_faces.envelope_slack: p1*p6 in the quadratic part and p1*p2*p6 in the radical product
proved_two_heavy_spectral_faces.consequence: the primitive three-variable envelope proves these two faces exactly

proved_residual_two_heavy_relative_inter.p3_p5_stationarity: the positive KKT equations force p2-p0=2*p6 and isolate one rational point
proved_residual_two_heavy_relative_inter.p5_p8_exclusion: with sqrt(R)=p4*p6*k, positivity forces p4*k>p5 and p6*k>p8, while the light KKT equation gives sqrt(3*p0*p1*p2/2)=-p0*(p5-p4*k)*(p8-p6*k)/(p5+p8)<0
proved_residual_two_heavy_relative_inter.consequence: no two-heavy relative interior can maximize the full problem; supports with at most one heavy coordinate lie in a proved primitive face
proved_residual_two_heavy_relative_inter.remaining_boundary: strata with at least one of p0,p1,p2,p4,p6 equal to zero

proved_zero_light_boundary.p4_zero: the heavy maximum is one of the p3 vertex, p8 vertex, or the {p5,p7} 2x2 spectral block; every branch lies in a proved primitive face
proved_zero_light_boundary.p1_or_p2_zero: if the other two of p0,p1,p2 are positive, turning on the missing coordinate gains order sqrt(epsilon) from the light radical against only order epsilon changes elsewhere, so such a point cannot maximize the violation
proved_zero_light_boundary.consequence: the scalar inequality is proved on the complete normalized simplex

residual_wedge_falsification.interpretation: targeted falsification only; it is not used as proof
